stemMarkdown: The average of 13 numbers is 44. When one more number is included, the average becomes the sum of all 14 numbers divided by 14. If the new number added is 134, find the new average (rounded to 2 decimal places).
solutionMarkdown: Sum of original 13 numbers $= 13 \times 44 = 572$. New sum $= 572 + 134 = 706$. New average $= \dfrac{706}{14} = 50.43$.
